name: Agent Security Bench (ASB)
description_en: Agent tasks and attacks spanning prompt injection, memory poisoning, and unsafe tool use.

size_reported: 覆盖 10 个场景、10 类 Agent、50 个正常 Agent 任务、20 个正常工具、400 个攻击工具、400 个攻击任务、10 个 PoT demonstrations、13 类攻击方法、11 类防御方法、7 个评价指标。论文摘要中也概括为：10 个场景、10 个 Agent、400+ 工具、27 种攻击/防御设置，并在 13 个 LLM backbones 上实验。
metrics_reported: 核心指标包括 ASR：攻击成功率，即攻击任务中成功调用目标攻击工具的比例；RR：拒绝率，即因指令具有攻击性而拒绝的比例；PNA：无攻击环境下正常任务完成率；BP：存在后门但无触发器时的正常任务完成率；FNR/FPR：检测防御中的假阴性/假阳性；NRP：综合任务能力与安全鲁棒性的指标，计算为 PNA × (1 − ASR)。
execution_reported: 模拟工具执行 / 程序化工具调用验证。ASB 不是连接真实 API 或真实外部系统，而是从预定义 JSONL 文件加载 normal tools 和 attack tools，实例化为 SimulatedTool 或 AttackerTool 对象；工具调用时返回预定义的 expected output / attack goal。

size_reported: InjecAgent 包含 17 个 user cases / user tools 和 62 个 attacker cases / attacker tools，两两组合形成 17 × 62 = 1054 个测试用例。其中 attacker cases 分为 30 个 direct harm attack 和 32 个 data stealing attack。论文还设置了 base setting 和 enhanced setting 两种攻击版本，因此每种 setting 下都有 1054 个测试用例。实验共评测 30 个 LLM Agents，其中包括 ReAct-prompted agents 和 OpenAI function-calling / fine-tuned agents。
metrics_reported: 核心指标是 Attack Success Rate, ASR。论文区分 ASR-all 和 ASR-valid：ASR-all 是所有输出上的攻击成功率；ASR-valid 是仅在有效输出中计算攻击成功比例，用于减少无效格式输出对安全性的干扰。此外还有 Valid Rate，即有效输出比例。Data Stealing 还细分 S1 数据提取成功率、S2 数据传输成功率 和整体成功率。
execution_reported: 模拟工具环境 / 调用意图级真实执行判定。论文并不是让 Agent 接入真实银行、邮箱、智能家居、文件系统等外部系统，而是基于工具规格和模型输出解析来判断 Agent 是否会调用有害工具。对于数据窃取类攻击，若 Agent 第一步选择调用数据提取工具，论文会进一步用 GPT-4 模拟该工具返回的敏感数据，再检查 Agent 是否会调用消息发送工具把数据发给攻击者。
curation_note_zh: 运行和指标描述优先采用 v2 核验详表；旧收集表存在套用其他基准流程的描述。

metrics_reported: 主要指标包括：Safety Score，0–3 分，越高越安全；Helpfulness Score，0–3 分，越高表示越能安全有效完成任务；Failure Incidence，即被安全评估器判定为失败/有风险的测试用例比例。安全分标签包括 Certain No Risk、Possible Mild Risk、Likely Mild Risk、Possible Severe Risk、Likely Severe Risk；有用性分标签包括 Excellent、Good、Unsatisfactory、Poor，并可二值化用于一致性计算
execution_reported: LM-emulated sandbox / 语言模型模拟执行环境。它不是程序化沙盒，也不是调用真实 API，而是用 GPT-4 根据工具说明模拟工具执行、状态变化和返回结果。工具覆盖终端、银行、邮箱、智能门锁、交通控制、机器人、Gmail、BankManager、GoogleCalendar、Twitter、Dropbox、Expedia、Binance、Shopify 等，其中不少工具没有现成公开 API 或难以真实沙盒化。

description_en: 4,184-instance benchmark evaluating LLM adherence to contextual non-disclosure policies under direct and indirect attacks.
description_zh: 含 4,184 条实例的基准，评测大语言模型在直接与间接攻击下对上下文保密策略的遵循。

description_zh: 合成多模态隐私基准（12 类敏感属性），审计多模态大语言模型的跨模态隐私推断风险。
size_reported: Synthetic multi-modal profiles with 12 sensitive attribute labels
metrics_reported: Cross-modal privacy inference accuracy vs. humans
execution_reported: Model API evaluation (static, image+text)

description_en: 158-scenario dataset evaluating multi-agent systems' understanding and preservation of contextual privacy in collaboration.
description_zh: 含 158 个高利害场景的数据集，评测多智能体系统在协作中对上下文隐私的理解与保护。
size_reported: 158 real-life high-stakes scenarios across 15 domains
metrics_reported: Contextual-privacy understanding; disclosure rate in multi-turn collaboration
execution_reported: Multi-agent conversation evaluation

name: Autonomous Jailbreak Agents (LRM)
description_en: Study and benchmark showing large reasoning models autonomously jailbreak other LLMs via multi-turn persuasion (97% ASR).
description_zh: 研究表明大推理模型可通过多轮说服自主越狱其他模型（成功率约 97%）。
size_reported: 70 harmful prompts across 7 sensitive domains; 4 LRM adversaries x 9 targets
metrics_reported: Multi-turn Attack Success Rate (ASR) via LLM judges

description_en: Multi-perspective safety/moderation benchmark (106 fine-grained categories) with a fine-tuned GemmaGuard moderation model.
description_zh: 多视角安全/审核基准（106 个细粒度类别），配套微调的 GemmaGuard 审核模型。
size_reported: 106 fine-grained categories (emotions, offensive, bias, safety)
metrics_reported: Macro-F1 (GGuard 0.832 vs. OpenAI Moderator 0.64, Llama Guard 0.61)
execution_reported: Classifier / moderation-model training + evaluation

name: APEX-Harm
description_en: Benchmark evaluating agent safety in shared professional workspaces under tool-use and collaboration risks.
description_zh: 在共享专业工作区中评测智能体在工具使用与协作风险下的安全性。
size_reported: Shared-workspace agent safety scenarios
metrics_reported: Safety / harm under tool-use and collaboration
execution_reported: Agent-in-workspace evaluation

name: AgentSecBench
description_en: Benchmark measuring prompt-injection, privacy leakage, and unsafe tool use in agentic workflows.
description_zh: 评测智能体工作流中的提示注入、隐私泄露与不安全工具使用。
size_reported: Agentic-workflow security scenarios
metrics_reported: Prompt-injection success; privacy leakage; unsafe-tool-use rate
execution_reported: Agent workflow evaluation

name: NetInjectBench
description_en: Benchmark for indirect prompt injection in tool-using agents with networked tool environments.
description_zh: 面向工具调用型智能体的间接提示注入基准，基于联网工具环境。
size_reported: Networked-tool indirect prompt-injection scenarios
metrics_reported: Indirect-injection Attack Success Rate (ASR)
execution_reported: Tool-using agent evaluation

name: SafeClawBench
description_en: Benchmark separating semantic, audit-evidence, and sandbox-failure safety risks for tool-using agents.
description_zh: 将工具调用型智能体的语义、审计证据与沙箱失效等安全风险分离的基准。
size_reported: Tool-use agent safety scenarios across risk dimensions
metrics_reported: Safety separation across semantic / audit / sandbox dimensions
execution_reported: Tool-using agent + sandbox evaluation

description_en: Indirect-prompt-injection arena and competition measuring agent vulnerability to injected instructions.
description_zh: 间接提示注入竞技场与竞赛，衡量智能体对注入指令的脆弱性。
size_reported: Indirect-prompt-injection challenge tasks
metrics_reported: Agent vulnerability / injection success rate
execution_reported: Agent-in-environment evaluation

name: MMJailBench
description_en: Factorized multimodal jailbreak benchmark disentangling vulnerabilities via controlled variations of intent, framing, and visual semantics.
description_zh: 因子化多模态越狱基准，通过控制有害意图、表述与视觉语义的变量来解耦脆弱性。
size_reported: Factorized multimodal jailbreak variations (intent / framing / visual semantics / carrier)
metrics_reported: Attack Success Rate (ASR) across controlled factors
execution_reported: Model API evaluation (static, multimodal)

name: XSB / MS-XSB
description_en: Scenario-based diagnostics for exaggerated LLM refusals: XSB (580 single-turn safe prompts) and MS-XSB (600 prompts in 30 multi-turn scenarios).
description_zh: 面向大语言模型过度拒答的基于场景的诊断基准：XSB（580 条单轮安全提示）与 MS-XSB（30 个多轮场景中的 600 条提示）。
size_reported: XSB: 580 safe prompts across 12 categories; MS-XSB: 600 prompts in 30 multi-turn scenarios
metrics_reported: Full Compliance / Partial Refusal / Full Refusal classification
execution_reported: Static prompt evaluation

name: CLEAR-Bias
description_en: Curated bias-elicitation prompt dataset with a scalable LLM-as-a-Judge framework for benchmarking adversarial bias robustness.
description_zh: 精心构建的偏见诱导提示数据集，配合可扩展的 LLM-as-a-Judge 框架，用于评测对抗性偏见的鲁棒性。
size_reported: Curated bias-related prompt set across sociocultural bias types
metrics_reported: Safety score via LLM-as-a-Judge; jailbreak effectiveness
execution_reported: Static prompt evaluation (LLM-as-a-Judge)

name: BiasFreeBench
description_en: Empirical benchmark comparing eight LLM bias-mitigation techniques with a response-level Bias-Free Score across multi-choice and multi-turn QA.
description_zh: 实证基准，在单选与多轮问答上以响应级 Bias-Free Score 对比八种大语言模型去偏方法。
size_reported: Unified query-response reorganization of existing datasets; 8 mitigation methods compared
metrics_reported: Bias-Free Score (fair, safe, anti-stereotypical)
execution_reported: Static prompt evaluation

name: MLLMU-Med
description_en: First benchmark for evaluating machine-unlearning quality in biomedical multimodal LLMs, targeting privacy protection and incorrectness removal.
description_zh: 首个评测生物医学多模态大语言模型机器遗忘质量的基准，聚焦隐私保护与错误知识移除。
size_reported: Synthetic private data + factual errors injected into training set
metrics_reported: Unlearning Efficiency Score
execution_reported: Unlearning pipeline evaluation

name: DAS Red-Teaming (Medical)
description_en: Dynamic, automatic, systematic red-teaming framework that continuously stress-tests medical LLMs across robustness, privacy, bias/fairness, and hallucination.
description_zh: 动态、自动、系统化的红队框架，持续对医学大语言模型在鲁棒性、隐私、偏见/公平与幻觉四个维度施压测试。
size_reported: Adversarial agent suite across 4 safety-critical axes; 15 LLMs evaluated
metrics_reported: Failure rate under dynamic vs. static evaluation (Benchmarking Gap)
execution_reported: Dynamic adversarial agent evaluation

name: BrowserART
description_en: BrowserART (Browser Agent Red-teaming Toolkit) is a test suite of 100 diverse browser-related harmful behaviors for red-teaming browser agents, spanning synthetic and real websites. Experiments show refusal-trained LLMs often comply as agents even when they refuse as chatbots (e.g., GPT-4o pursued 98/100 harmful behaviors with human rewrites).
description_zh: BrowserART（浏览器智能体红队工具包）是一套包含 100 个浏览器相关有害行为的测试集，用于红队测试浏览器智能体，覆盖合成与真实网站。实验表明，经拒答训练的 LLM 作为智能体时往往会遵从有害指令，而作为聊天机器人时会拒绝（如 GPT-4o 在人工改写后尝试了 98/100 个有害行为）。
size_reported: 100 harmful browser-related behaviors across 40 synthetic websites (19 domains) and real websites
metrics_reported: Agent pursuit of harmful behaviors (e.g., GPT-4o 98/100, o1-preview 63/100 with human rewrites)
execution_reported: Dynamic red-teaming of browser agents on synthetic + real websites

name: OutSafe-Bench
description_en: OutSafe-Bench is a comprehensive multimodal content-safety evaluation suite covering four modalities (18,000+ bilingual text prompts, 4,500 images, 450 audio clips, 450 videos) across nine content risk categories, with a Multidimensional Cross Risk Score (MCRS) and FairScore multi-reviewer aggregation.
description_zh: OutSafe-Bench 是一套覆盖四模态（18,000+ 中英双语文本提示、4,500 图像、450 音频、450 视频）的综合多模态内容安全评测基准，涵盖九类内容风险，提出多维交叉风险分数（MCRS）与 FairScore 多评审聚合框架。
size_reported: 18,000+ bilingual (EN/ZH) text prompts, 4,500 images, 450 audio clips, 450 videos across 9 content risk categories
metrics_reported: Multidimensional Cross Risk Score (MCRS); FairScore (explainable multi-reviewer weighted aggregation)
execution_reported: Static multimodal content-safety evaluation of 9 MLLMs

name: OmniSafeBench-MM
description_en: OmniSafeBench-MM is a unified toolbox for multimodal jailbreak attack-defense evaluation, integrating 13 attack methods and 15 defense strategies over a dataset spanning 9 risk domains and 50 fine-grained categories, with a three-dimensional evaluation protocol (harmfulness, intent alignment, response detail).
description_zh: OmniSafeBench-MM 是一个统一的多模态越狱攻防评测工具箱，集成了 13 种攻击方法与 15 种防御策略，覆盖 9 大风险域与 50 个细粒度类别，并提出三维评测协议（危害性、意图对齐、回复详略）。
size_reported: Dataset spanning 9 risk domains and 50 fine-grained categories; 13 attack + 15 defense methods; consultative/imperative/declarative inquiry types
metrics_reported: Three-dimensional score: harmfulness (multi-level), intent alignment, response detail level
execution_reported: Multimodal jailbreak attack-defense evaluation on 10 open + 8 closed MLLMs

name: JailFlipBench
description_en: JailFlipBench captures 'implicit harm' = incorrectly answering harmless-looking inputs, spanning single-modal, multimodal, and factual-extension scenarios with diverse metrics, revealing that alignment failures extend beyond conventional overt jailbreaks.
description_zh: JailFlipBench 刻画“隐式危害”——即对看似无害的输入给出错误回答，覆盖单模态、多模态与事实扩展场景并采用多样指标，揭示对齐失效远超传统显式越狱的范畴。
size_reported: Single-modal, multimodal, and factual-extension implicit-harm scenarios
metrics_reported: Diverse implicit-harm metrics across modality scenarios
execution_reported: Static evaluation of implicit-harm / alignment-failure risks

name: Camouflaged Jailbreak Prompts
description_en: Camouflaged Jailbreak Prompts (Behind the Mask) is a benchmark of 500 curated examples (400 harmful, 100 benign) embedding malicious intent within seemingly benign language, with a multi-faceted evaluation framework measuring harmfulness across seven dimensions.
description_zh: Camouflaged Jailbreak Prompts（Behind the Mask）是一个包含 500 条精心构建示例（400 有害、100 良性）的基准，将恶意意图嵌入看似无害的语言中，并提出从七个维度衡量有害性的多面评测框架。
size_reported: 500 curated examples (400 harmful + 100 benign prompts)
metrics_reported: Seven-dimension harmfulness score (Safety Awareness, Technical Feasibility, Implementation Safeguards, Harmful Potential, Educational Value, Content Quality, Compliance)
execution_reported: Static camouflaged-jailbreak prompt evaluation

name: MCBench
description_en: MCBench is a multicontext safety assessment benchmark for omni LLMs (vision/audio/text) with 1,196 scenarios spanning four safety categories that require integrating multiple modalities, each unsafe scenario paired with a minimally different safe counterpart to assess model sensitivity.
description_zh: MCBench 是面向全模态大模型（视觉/音频/文本）的多语境安全评测基准，含 1,196 个场景，覆盖四类安全主题且需跨模态整合，每个不安全场景都配有一个最小差异的安全对照以评估模型敏感性。
size_reported: 1,196 scenarios spanning four safety categories requiring multi-modal integration
metrics_reported: Safety assessment with minimally-different safe/unsafe counterpart sensitivity
execution_reported: Omni-LLM cross-modal reasoning safety evaluation

name: MATEBench
description_en: MATEBench is a trajectory-level security-auditing benchmark for mobile agents: from a knowledge base of 140K synthesized policy-conditioned trajectories, it releases two synthetic and one real-world subset of manually collected trajectories, evaluating whether an agent's actions violate natural-language security policies. Accepted to USENIX Security 2026.
description_zh: MATEBench 是面向移动智能体的轨迹级安全审计基准：基于 14 万条合成的策略条件轨迹知识库，发布两个合成子集与一个真实人工采集子集，评测智能体动作是否违反自然语言安全策略。已被 USENIX Security 2026 接收。
size_reported: 140K synthesized policy-conditioned trajectories; benchmark = two synthetic + one real-world subset of manually collected mobile-agent trajectories
metrics_reported: Trajectory policy-violation detection accuracy (MATE >95% on MATEBench)
execution_reported: Synthesis-driven trajectory learning / policy-conditioned auditing of mobile agents
availability_reported: 是（框架与基准公开，USENIX Security 2026）

name: Adaptive Adversaries
description_en: Adaptive Adversaries is a multi-turn, multi-LLM benchmark for agent security where an autonomous LLM attacker observes prior defender responses and pivots across rounds against memoryless defenders. It spans 21 evaluation scenarios (+10 dev) in a 3x3 attacker-defender matrix (945 battles) plus 18,422 competition battles.
description_zh: Adaptive Adversaries 是一个多轮、多 LLM 的智能体安全基准：自主 LLM 攻击方观察防御方历史回复并在多轮中调整策略，对抗无记忆防御方。包含 21 个评测场景（+10 开发）的 3×3 攻防矩阵（945 场对战）及 18,422 场竞赛对战。
size_reported: 21 evaluation scenarios (+10 dev); 3x3 attacker-defender matrix = 945 battles; 18,422 gpt-oss-20b competition battles
metrics_reported: Attack success rate (ASR) over adaptive multi-round attacks (0-1% round-1, 5.4-14.0% over 15 rounds)
execution_reported: Adaptive multi-turn LLM attacker vs memoryless defender with frozen replay harness
availability_reported: 是（基准、编排器与基线公开）

name: Open Security Benchmark
description_en: Open Security Benchmark (OSB) benchmarks agentic AI on enterprise security posture management, surfacing a curated, frozen enterprise environment evaluated across two modalities: text-to-SQL over a relational snapshot and each vendor's native API over a served instance, with closed-form ground truth.
description_zh: Open Security Benchmark（OSB）面向企业安全态势管理的智能体 AI，提供一个精心构建、冻结的企业环境，通过两种模态评测——关系快照上的 text-to-SQL 与各厂商原生 API 实例——并以闭合形式真实标签作为锚定。
size_reported: Curated frozen enterprise security-state snapshot; two identity-security packs; synthetic-organization datasets at multiple scales
metrics_reported: Posture-investigation scoring across text-to-SQL and vendor-native API modalities
execution_reported: Agentic cyber-defense posture investigation benchmark

name: Boiling the Frog
description_en: Boiling the Frog is a multi-turn benchmark for agentic safety that evaluates whether tool-using AI models in corporate/office settings are susceptible to incremental attacks. Each scenario starts with benign workspace edits and later introduces a risk-bearing request, scoring whether the resulting artifact state becomes unsafe across a nine-model panel.
description_zh: Boiling the Frog 是一个面向智能体安全的多轮基准，评测部署于企业/办公场景、具备工具调用能力的 AI 模型是否易受渐进式攻击。每个场景以良性工作区编辑开始，随后引入风险请求，并依据九模型面板评分最终产物状态是否变得不安全。
size_reported: Stateful multi-turn incremental-attack scenarios in corporate/office settings with persistent workspace; nine-model panel
metrics_reported: Strict attack success rate (ASR): aggregate 44.4%, model range 20.5%-92.9%
execution_reported: Stateful multi-turn evaluation scoring artifact-state safety

description_en: CySecBench: Generative AI-based CyberSecurity-focused Prompt Dataset for Benchmarking Large Language Models (arXiv:2501.01335, 2025). Scope: Cybersecurity Benchmark Jailbreaking Prompt Dataset.
